protocol.controls: same common harness on both sides; separate sources and targets; frozen binaries hashed before and after each timing run; no overlapping builds/tests
protocol.comparison: geometric mean of two per-run mean estimates; saved confidence intervals are per run, not intervals for the difference
protocol.optional_input: Nx1 cells repeating negative zero, integer, blank, missing, minimum subnormal; prepare includes validation, identity, discard; materialize also constructs and drops user value. No actual handle lookup.
protocol.rtd_input: prevalidated 16 KiB (one part) or 1 MiB (64 parts) borrowed topics; rejection and reuse exclude fixture setup and input validation. Admitted includes new insertion and rollback.

reproduction.paired_runner:
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,os,json,hashlib,time
r=Path(__file__).parent
m=json.loads((r/'provenance.json').read_text())
filters={'argument_ingress':r'^argument_ingress/(optional_numeric/.+|f64/(plain|with_identity)|matrix_f64_100k/prepare_identity|matrix_ref_f64_100k/prepare_materialize)$','rtd_prepare':r'^rtd_admission/'}
runs=[]
for i,side in enumerate(['candidate','baseline','baseline','candidate']):
 for name,pattern in filters.items():
  binary=r/'frozen'/side/name
  assert hashlib.sha256(binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==m['binaries'][side][name]
  key=f'{i+1}-{side}-{name}'
  env=os.environ.copy();env.update(CRITERION_HOME=str(r/'criterion'/key),XLFN_BENCH_MEASUREMENT_MS='1500')
  cmd=[str(binary),pattern,'--bench','--sample-size','20','--warm-up-time','0.3','--measurement-time','1.5','--noplot']
  start=time.time()
  with (r/f'{key}.log').open('w') as out: subprocess.run(cmd,env=env,stdout=out,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
  assert hashlib.sha256(binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==m['binaries'][side][name]
  runs.append(dict(key=key,side=side,benchmark=name,command=cmd,started=start,elapsed=time.time()-start))
  (r/'runs.json').write_text(json.dumps(runs,indent=2))
  print(key,round(runs[-1]['elapsed'],1),flush=True)
